WITH avg_qty AS (
  SELECT l_partkey, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_q
  FROM lineitem
  GROUP BY l_partkey
)
SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem
JOIN part ON part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey
JOIN avg_qty ON avg_qty.l_partkey = part.p_partkey
WHERE part.p_brand = 'Brand#23'
  AND part.p_container = 'WRAP BAG'
  AND lineitem.l_quantity < 0.2 * avg_qty.avg_q
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sum(l_extendedprice)/7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM (
    SELECT l_extendedprice, l_quantity,
           avg(l_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY l_partkey) AS avg_q
    FROM lineitem
    JOIN part ON part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey
    WHERE part.p_brand = 'Brand#25'
      AND part.p_container = 'WRAP PACK'
) t
WHERE l_quantity < 0.2 * avg_q
LIMIT 1;
